cues: Step one is concentration by froth flotation.
Powdered ore is stirred in water with a little pine oil, and air is blown through.
Sulphide particles are wetted by the oil, cling to the air bubbles and rise as a froth.
The earthy gangue, wetted by water, sinks.
It works because the ore is a sulphide.
